name: Iran-Nakhchivan Gas Pipeline (Julfa)

values.OtherEnglishNames: Julfa-Nakhchivan Gas Pipeline, Iran-Nakhchivan Gas Swap Pipeline
values.RouteNotes: Cross-border delivery spur crossing the Aras River at Jolfa (Iran) / Julfa (Nakhchivan) into the Azerbaijani exclave. No official GIS route located; corridor only. Fed from Iran's NW gas grid; distinct crossing from P0449 (Iran-Armenia, Norduz) and unrelated to P0748 (Azerbaijan->Iran import at Astara).

researcher_notes: KEEP as new_row (not a fold into P0748). Re-checked match-to-existing against all 42 Iran gas rows: no existing row covers the Iran->Nakhchivan delivery direction. P0748 (Hajiqabul-Astara-Abadan) is the Azerbaijan->Iran IMPORT at Astara running south to Abadan on the Caspian side; P0449 (Iran-Armenia) crosses at Norduz to Sardarian. The Nakhchivan delivery is a physically distinct cross-border spur crossing the Aras at Jolfa/Julfa, fed from Iran's NW grid. Confirmed by 2 independent sources: Columbia CGEP ('Iran built a pipeline from Azerbaijan mainland to Jolfa and across into Nakhchivan'; '0.3-0.4 bcm/y since 2006'; 'Azerbaijan supplies an equivalent volume to Iran at Astara, while Iran delivers gas to Nakhchivan at Julfa') and MENA Affairs (2004 20-yr agreement, implemented 2005, ~350 mcm/yr, 15% deducted as transit fee). Add-threshold met: (a) sponsor = Iran/NIGC delivery side under Azerbaijan-Iran swap; (b) endpoints Jolfa (Iran) -> Nakhchivan; (c) concrete step far exceeded -- operating since 2006. Confidence: existence + operating status HIGH (2 independent); capacity approximate (0.3-0.4 bcm/y, staged 0.35) and length/diameter unpinnable from public sources -> left blank per no-fabrication rule, overall tier MEDIUM. Owner/operator left blank (no source names the specific owner of this line; NIGC is the presumed Iranian operator but unverified). Route: no official GIS geometry found; short border crossing at the Aras, corridor described in RouteNotes only -- not a sourced geometry, so no Route [ref]. Note the internal Nakhchivan-Sadarak trunk (81.6 km, completed 2013, preslib.az) is a downstream distribution line inside the exclave, NOT this cross-border crossing.
